program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg (mode g -1))
                  (cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)) #:when (!= (at g r c) bg))
                           (list r c (at g r c))))
                  (colors (unique (map third cells)))
                  (c1 (first colors))
                  (c2 (second colors))
                  (rmin (min-of first cells))
                  (rmax (max-of first cells))
                  (cmin (min-of second cells))
                  (cmax (max-of second cells))
                  (rmid (quotient (+ rmin rmax) 2))
                  (shift (if (or (zero? c1) (zero? c2))
                             (let ((nz (filter (lambda (c) (!= (third c) 0)) cells)))
                               (+ 1 (- (max-of second nz) (min-of second nz))))
                             (+ 1 (- cmax cmin))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww))) (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
             (for ((cell cells))
               (let* ((r (first cell))
                      (c (second cell))
                      (v (third cell))
                      (nv (if (= v c1) c2 c1)))
                 (if (> r rmid)
                     (let ((nc (+ c shift)))
                       (when
                         (and (>= nc 0) (< nc ww))
                         (hash-set! result (list r nc) nv)))
                     (hash-set! result (list r c) nv))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
